verdict.rationale: Bento documents OpenTelemetry span capture with an explorable span tree, and automatic capture of every model call, tool call and agent step (e.g., Google ADK). It also groups runs via `session_id` passed to `init()` and applied to every span, and via a shared `convo_id` that ties runs into conversations. Missing for 10: detailed docs on parent/child span nesting semantics for multi-step runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the session/thread grouping views.
